text:
Done — I refreshed the app’s visual style and started splitting the UI into smaller files without changing the app’s behavior.

What I changed:
- Updated the global styling in `src/index.css` for a cleaner, more modern base look.
- Extracted the storefront/homepage UI into a new component file: `src/components/storefront.tsx`.
- Moved the admin inventory screen into `src/components/admin/AdminInventory.tsx`.
- Kept compatibility by making `src/components/AdminView.tsx` re-export the new admin component.
- Simplified `src/App.tsx` to focus on state and composition instead of a huge inline UI block.

Note:
- I wasn’t able to complete a build check because the container doesn’t have `vite` installed in the current environment.
